claim: Xu and colleagues report that consecutive sentence-level repetition occurs in 0.02% of the human Wikitext-103 corpus, which they contrast with the model's rate under greedy decoding.

claim: Xu and colleagues name a self-reinforcement effect in which each further repetition of a sentence in the context raises the model's probability of generating that sentence again.

claim: Xu and colleagues measure that a single sentence-level context repetition already raises the probability of repeating in more than ninety per cent of tokens, before any token has actually been repeated at the current step.

modelEra: 16-layer Transformer decoder 750M on Wikitext-103, 2022; register measured: Wikipedia, BookCorpus, random-token corpora
